long_biography.plain_text:
Entrepreneur Stephen Timoney has made a permanent home central to his investment in the Caledonia Gladiators basketball franchise. A club renting municipal sports halls could lose its playing space to other events. He and his wife, Alison, acquired Playsport in East Kilbride and established an arena there. His commercial plan combines ticket sales, broadcasts and sponsorship with the wider leisure centre, while supporting men's and women's teams equally.

The couple also funded Crossbasket House, which provides free accommodation for families whose children are receiving hospital treatment in Glasgow. Residents have their own bedrooms and bathrooms, with shared kitchens and living spaces. The house lets parents remain near the hospital when they cannot stay overnight on a ward.
